title: The Empress (hotel)
scope: The standing historic Empress Hotel exterior, including the harbor-facing lodge, its north and south wings and the wings on the hotel’s hillside side.
limitations: Storey bays, lancets and copper roof joints are simplified. Rear roof equipment and later minor changes are generalized.
The scope is the hotel exterior. The conference center, harbor causeway, landscaping and interiors are outside the model.
